name: Cloudflare R2 Worker gateway
manualSteps: Implement the generated authorization and completion callbacks against the application's real session, object ownership, and one-time completion state.

Deploy edge/r2-worker and store only its HTTPS origin as NEXT_PUBLIC_R2_WORKER_ORIGIN; no R2 S3 access key or secret is used.
Exercise an authorized upload and exact-byte readback, reject an unauthorized object, and clean up only the unique probe object.
